timeline: WSL/local monotonic receive intervals; variable frame rate; no synthetic frames
utc_scope: local host receive wall clock; not camera exposure time
recording_scope: Received preview frames only; not the camera internal high-speed recording
raw_encoding: H.264 CRF18 yuv420p; unannotated, not lossless sensor data
annotations: Exact frame preferred; recent past overlay delay labelled; future/stale/other-ROI results excluded

piv_display.zero_motion: No directional arrow below 3 display pixels
piv_display.glyph: Thin open arrowhead; no filled triangle
piv_display.smoothing: Display only: local spatial mean then causal EMA; no missing-cell persistence; raw data unchanged

overlay_display.brightness: Constant throughout the original validity window
overlay_display.piv_smoothing: Optional display-only spatial mean and causal temporal filter; raw observations unchanged
